items.title: Hurricane Isaias strengthens to a major category three storm
items.summary: El Niño has led to a quiet season so far but the first Atlantic hurricane of the year is set to make landfall later on Friday into Saturday across the US Gulf Coast.

items.title: Isaias becomes major category three storm before landfall
items.summary: Isaias, the first hurricane of the Atlantic season has been continuing to strengthen and is now a category three 'major' hurricane.
